units.source_text: 秀男停下操作梭子的手，望了望这边，但他没有立即站起来。

en.t: Hideo stopped working the shuttle and glanced over this way, but he did not stand up right away.

units.source_text: 也许是太累了，但他知道有客人，又不好意思伸懒腰。

en.t: Perhaps he was too tired, but he knew there were guests present and felt too embarrassed to stretch.

units.source_text: 他擦了一把脸，就走了过来。

en.t: He wiped his face once, then came over.
